title: DC-link capacitor selection and placement
purpose: Select DC-link capacitance, technology and placement for SiC bridges and size DC-blocking capacitors in transformer-coupled bridges.
applicable_conditions: Voltage-source bridges with switched DC-link current
Hundreds of volts, tens to hundreds of kHz
not_applicable: Inductor-ripple output filters of low-voltage converters
principles: C >= dQ_max / dV over all operating corners
RMS ripple current at f_sw and temperature sets technology and count
Bulk film plus distributed HV ceramics at each bridge leg
Voltage rating with margin (TI ratios observed, no derating rule stated)
DC-blocking capacitor with resonance a decade below f_s
Account for ceramic DC-bias capacitance loss
procedure: Compute capacitor current, dQ and I_rms at every corner
Select film capacitors for C, V and I_rms
Add HV ceramics beside each leg
component_considerations: Film ripple-current and ESR curves (obtain datasheets)
HV MLCC voltage rating and DC-bias curve
pcb_constraints: Ceramics adjacent to switch pins (KR-PCB-004, PE-PCB-002/003)
verification_methods: Measure ripple voltage and capacitor temperature
